storyline.real: Verstappen wins from pole. Pérez stops first, on lap 15; Leclerc runs six laps longer and makes only one stop. Red Bull switches Pérez to a second stop, and on fresher tyres he closes in over the last laps, but Leclerc holds second by 1.3 s and takes second in the championship, three points ahead of him.

mastery.label: Beat Pérez on one stop, as Leclerc did

hidden.label: Beat Pérez without a single lap of tyre management

eras.briefing: Yas Marina, 2022, the season finale. Verstappen leads from pole and Pérez runs second. You run Leclerc's Ferrari in third, and second place in the championship is between you and Pérez. Finish ahead of him.
